title: All Timesheets permissions OFF and Reports OFF: no timesheet navigation anywhere
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with both Timesheets boxes OFF and Reports OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Look at the top navigation.
  3. Look at the left sidebar.
  4. Open a work order and look for a timesheet section.
custom_expected:
There is no Timesheets entry in the top navigation or the sidebar.

The work order shows no timesheet edit option.

The Timesheet activities report is not in Reports (Reports is off).
